algorithm: RBF Random Fourier Features MMD squared mean distance
split: Concatenate original Batch1..6 rows. default_rng(42).permutation(N), Reference first floor(N/2), Calibration next floor((N-ref)/2), internal evaluation remainder. No gas labels or gas stratification.
null_windows: Calibration/internal evaluation preserve their random permutation order; nonoverlapping100-row pooled mixture windows. These are NOT chronological or within-Batch normal windows. This null differs from target file-order windows.
target_windows: Separately per Batch, original file source-line order, nonoverlapping100; discard and log tail<100. No cross-target-Batch windows; no wall-clock claim.
preprocessing: Median Imputer then StandardScaler fitted ONLY Reference Pool. Same feature order/types as official Model A; distinct subset-fitted objects. No all-reference refit after threshold. No target fit.
bandwidth: Impute/scale Reference only. default_rng(42).choice(n,min(n,1024),replace=False). Upper-triangle squared Euclidean pair distances; omit<=1e-12. sigma²=median positive squared distances; gamma=1/(2*sigma²). No positive distance => stop; no fallback gamma.
threshold: At least10 full Calibration windows, percentile95 via np.quantile(method=linear). Warn iff score>threshold; equality baseline. Same frozen Reference embedding at use.
missing: Reorder exact named f001..f128 schema; reject extra/duplicate/missing columns, nonnumeric/boolean/infinity/all-missing row or feature. Partial NaN median-imputed using Reference only; record counts. Window-local all-missing feature => unavailable.
labels: No labels in fit/calibrate/score/API or serialized detector. Read gas labels only after detector/score hashes are locked, for mixture and saved-SVM error analysis.
normal_warning: Separate14 expected pooled internal windows; descriptive reference-internal warning rate, not true normal-sensor false positive rate or 5% guarantee.
metrics: n, full/invalid windows, dropped rows, mean/median/max MMD, alerts/rate, consecutive alert runs; posthoc errors/support/mixture total variation; Spearman(score,window_error) descriptive, no p/inference. No2-point Batch correlation.
classifier: Official Model A unchanged; zero new classifier fits/predictions. Reuse stage6 B_SVM_balanced saved Batch7/8 predictions, verify stage7 replay and truth IDs.
stop: Leakage/duplicate overlap/preservation/plan mismatch, insufficient null windows or degenerate Reference => abort, no altered seed/window/bandwidth/threshold retry.
conclusion: A only if valid target scores, independent-row internal warning estimate, fixed threshold, unlabeled API, replay, input handling and preservation tests pass. A is technical prototype success, not physical drift detection accuracy. B partial with noncritical missing evidence, C substantial leakage/replay failure.
ui: CSV service API and optional Streamlit adapter; live Streamlit not installed initially. Do not infer web deployment validation from backend tests.
limits: 분포 변화 ≠ 센서 고장 ≠ 모델 성능 저하. 반복 사용한 개발 자료의 사후 진단이며 독립 Test가 아님. 실제 센서 드리프트 탐지 정확도를 측정하지 않음. Batch9~10 신규 점수·평가 없음. 공식 Model A 유지. Shared Reference induces score dependence; pooled historical data may already drift; file-order windows may concentrate gases. No event labels, exact timestamps, concentrations or environment attribution. Only2 Batch8 full windows.
